summary.tldr: Creates a Criminal Code offence for some government officers or employees who bring up medical assistance in dying without being asked.
what_it_does: Makes it an offence, punishable on summary conviction, for a federal or provincial officer or employee to start a discussion about medical assistance in dying with a person.
Applies only when the person is in a position of trust or authority over that person because of their job.
Applies only when they know the person did not specifically ask to have that discussion.
Does not apply to medical practitioners or registered nurses, including nurse practitioners.
summary.background: The bill adds a new offence to the Criminal Code after section 241.3.
